current: There is no separate ledger sink, but there is an in-tree path by which financial outcomes travel to the centre's ledger, and it does what this requirement forbids. A cell's orders, fills and crosses reach the centre only inside a CellStateDelta (backend/crates/edge/qip-edge/src/mesh.rs:201-254), where they are per-interval and incremental ('a receiver adds these rather than replacing'), built from the current pass's WorkReport (qip-edge/src/cell.rs:7520 Cell::state_delta); the centre books them via Platform::ingest_cell_report -> CentralPlane::settle -> book_settlement. The uplink retries on a bounded ladder and then dead-letters the delta (qip-edge/src/mesh.rs:409 'Deltas that spent the whole ladder and were recorded as dead letters'), or refuses it outright while the circuit is open; the node keeps dead letters in memory only (qip-edge-node/src/mesh.rs:64-69, DEAD_LETTER_CAPACITY = 64, 'a lost message is superseded by the next one') and nothing redrives them. qip-mesh/src/spine.rs:14 states the up direction is 'not durable'. The test a_tick_against_an_unreachable_centre_reports_it_and_leaves_the_cell_running (qip-edge-node/tests/mesh.rs:375, asserting dead_lettered at :388 and :392) pins that behaviour. The cell's own local journal still holds its decisions, but nothing replays them into the centre. The centre's own event log fails closed (refuses a new append rather than evicting a permanent record), which is a different behaviour from retrying a commit.

gap: The only in-tree route from a cell's financial outcomes to the centre's ledger dead-letters them after a bounded retry (or refuses them with the circuit open) and never redrives them, so an outage longer than the retry ladder loses that interval's orders/fills/crosses from the centre's books -- the exact 'dropped, dead-lettered' outcome the requirement forbids. What is needed: outcome-bearing deltas (or a dedicated outcome stream) spooled durably at the cell (qip_transport::spool::DurableSpool already exists and is used for the capital downlink) and retried without limit, a poison outcome stopping its partition rather than being skipped, and the backlog surfaced (LEDGER-044). None of this needs Spanner or a refused crate, so it is not BLOCKED; no chaos test exists.

So a break the centre finds itself (a BreakOrigin::UnsentFill from settle) is displayed to operators (halted_by_centre) and does not narrow or stop the cell. current: The desk's cash and positions are rebuilt from the authoritative record alone and then verified against statements. Platform::resume_book folds the event log's FillBooked and LotAdjusted records into TrackedCapital at assembly, so a process holding none of its predecessor's memory -- every registry, aggregate and view rebuilt or empty -- reaches the same cash and the same positions. Platform::reconcile_wallet, run by the LEARN stage on every cycle, then hands the wallet the book's view of the desk's cash and of each position the book holds at the desk's venue that a statement names, and qip_capital_fabric::wallet::Wallet::reconcile halts (never corrects) any venue-asset whose statement diverges beyond its tolerance. The log is hash-chained, so a log altered on disk is refused at assembly rather than rebuilt from.
evidence: backend/crates/runtime/qip-kernel/src/platform.rs (fn resume_book; fn reconcile_wallet: one LedgerView for the desk's cash and one per held instrument a statement names)
verification: cargo test -p qip-kernel --test ledger -- with_every_derived_store_gone_the_log_and_the_statements_alone_rebuild_and_verify_the_desks_cash_and_positions: a first process fills an order and reconciles clean against statements of its cash and its position; a second process over the same log file rebuilds the same cash and position and reconciles clean against the same statements; a statement ten shares short then halts that holding with delta -10 and not the cash; and the log with one booked quantity altered on disk refuses to assemble. Mutations, each restored byte-for-byte: removing the resume_book call failed it with 'the log rebuilt a different cash balance' (10000000 against 9939975.9982); withholding the position LedgerViews failed its premise with the agreeing statement halted as unrecorded_by_ledger (observed 600 against expected 0).
notes: verify: status unchanged; deployable true->false. The cash half needs a custody statement and every environment declines QIP_WALLET_STATEMENT_PATH, and the position half depends on cell reports from undeployed edge nodes. Added truth_loop's rebuild-from-the-log-alone acceptance test, which covers the cash registry's rebuild but does not poison caches or compare against venue/custody statements. | 2026-10-05: COMPLETE for the platform's book of record, the desk's.
